title: Pullback composition commutes with a sheaf in degree zero
statement: Let Λ be a commutative ring, T,T₂,T₁ schemes [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], π₂:T₂→T and π₁:T₁→T₂ arbitrary morphisms, and F an étale Λ-module sheaf on T [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves]. The π₁-derived pullback of the π₂ single-complex comparison, followed by the π₁ single-complex comparison and the degree-zero image of the inverse sheaf composition comparison π₁*π₂*F→(π₁≫π₂)*F, equals the inverse derived composition comparison evaluated on F[0], followed by the single-complex comparison for π₁≫π₂. This is an identity only on T₁; it contains no square, no morphism e and no direct image.

source.place: Proof step 2 (coefficient identity); definitions mapDerivedCategoryPlusSingleFunctor, mapDerivedCategoryPlusCompIso, mapDerivedCategoryPlusNatIso, and their factorization lemmas

proof.text: For arbitrary additive functors G and H, compare their levelwise single-complex comparisons with the single-complex comparison for G ⋙ H. Extensionality reduces equality to each integer degree. At the supported degree use singleMapHomologicalComplex_hom_app_self and functoriality; at every other degree use singleMapHomologicalComplex_hom_app_ne and preservation of zero morphisms. Prove likewise compatibility with an arbitrary natural isomorphism e : G ≅ H, degreewise using the single-complex comparison and the single functor on e.hom.

Expand each mapDerivedCategorySingleFunctor component as mapDerivedCategoryFactors.hom followed by Q of the singleMapHomologicalComplex component (single_hom). For composition move the factorization comparison across the localized single comparison by mapDerivedCategoryFactors_hom_naturality_assoc; combine Q maps, use the degreewise equality, and apply mapDerivedCategoryCompIso_fac, whose levelwise composition comparison is the identity. For a natural isomorphism use mapDerivedCategoryNatIso_fac_assoc followed by the second degreewise equality. This proves derived composition compatibility and derived natural-isomorphism compatibility separately, without passing through the homotopy quotient.

Apply the faithful inclusion DerivedCategory.Plus.ι to each bounded-below compatibility equation. The inclusion lemmas for mapDerivedCategoryPlusSingleFunctor, mapDerivedCategoryPlusCompIso, and mapDerivedCategoryPlusNatIso reduce them to the corresponding proved unbounded equations; maps of the restricted functors and the single functor agree definitionally with their unbounded maps. Specialize to G = π₂* and H = π₁* and e = upperStarComp. Cancel the epimorphism upperStarPlusComp.hom at F[0], expand its two factors, use the two bounded-below equations, then cancel the single-functor image of e.hom followed by e.inv. This is exactly the displayed inverse orientation.

theorem Etale.upperStarPlusComp_single
    {T T₁ T₂ : Scheme.{u}} (π₁ : T₁ ⟶ T₂) (π₂ : T₂ ⟶ T)
    (F : Sheaf T.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)) :
    D+((π₁)^*[ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ]).map
        ((((π₂)^*[ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ]).mapDerivedCategoryPlusSingleFunctor 0).hom.app F) ≫
      ((((π₁)^*[ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ]).mapDerivedCategoryPlusSingleFunctor 0).hom.app
        (((π₂)^*[ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ]).obj F)) ≫
      (DerivedCategory.Plus.singleFunctor _ 0).map
        ((Etale.upperStarComp (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) π₁ π₂ (π₁ ≫ π₂) rfl).inv.app F) =
    (Etale.upperStarPlusComp (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) π₁ π₂).inv.app
        ((DerivedCategory.Plus.singleFunctor _ 0).obj F) ≫
      ((((π₁ ≫ π₂)^*[ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ]).mapDerivedCategoryPlusSingleFunctor 0).hom.app F)
